predecessors.name: Principality of Chernigov
predecessors.text: Murom and Ryazan, bequeathed with Chernigov in 1054: 'In 1127, it became a separate principality and was known as the Principality of Murom-Ryazan'

successors.name: Grand Principality of Moscow
successors.text: 'In 1392, Vasily I of Moscow obtained a patent from Tokhtamysh authorizing the annexation of the Murom principality'

ledger.x: 1127: Murom-Ryazan becomes a separate principality under Yaroslav Sviatoslavich.

wars.name: Mongol invasion of Rus (Murom, 1237-1238)
wars.outcome: 'Murom was destroyed or at least devastated by the Mongol invasion of 1237-1238'; ravaged again in 1283 and 1293.

certainty.note: No survey or treaty line; only the Oka tributaries and the neighbours named on the page.
